The '''Imp Stalkers''' are a variant of [[Imp/Doom: The Dark Ages|Imp]]. They appear in [[Doom: The Dark Ages]] as a common enemy, first appearing in Village of Khalim.

== Appearance ==
The Imp Stalker is a tall demon, slightly taller than the Slayer. The Stalker has a slightly muscular build, with spikes protruding from its shoulders and elbows. It also has sharp, fiery claws on its hands.

On its face, the stalker also has red eyes, an open mouth, sharp teeth, and a jawline similar to [[Hell Knight/Doom: The Dark Ages|Hell Knights]].

==Description==
Larger and smarter than their Imp kin, they hunt relentlessly, wielding fire that tracks and predicts their prey's movements. In close quarters, their searing claws shred flesh and metal alike. Their reckless ferocity makes them ideal frontline warriors.

== Abilities ==

=== Idle ===
When they are not fighting, Imp Stalkers are mainly stationary, while also moving very slowly towards the player. Sometimes, while in combat, Stalkers will strafe out of the way to avoid damage.

=== Melee ===

==== Slash ====
When the player is close to the Imp, it will hit the player, knocking them back and dealing a moderate amount of damage.

==== Charge ====
During combat, the Stalker can charge towards the player, dealing a hefty amount of damage. This attack can be parried.

=== Ranged ===

==== Fireball ====
In combat, Imp Stalkers can fire a homing, normal-speed fireball in the shape of a cross. This attack can be either be parryable or not.

==== Firewall ====
Similar to normal [[Imp/Doom: The Dark Ages|Imp]] firewalls, Imp Stalkers can throw homing, normal speed firewalls, similar to an Armored [[Mancubus/Doom: The Dark Ages|Mancubus]] firewall. However, this cannot be parried, unlike the fireball, and is also much wider than it, making it hard to dodge normally.

== Strategy ==

=== Neutral ===
While Imp Stalkers are powerful and are very potent, they can still be taken down easily. A normal [[Impaler]] headshot will instakill a normal Stalker, a [[Dreadmace]] hit, and a SSG shot from point blank. If parried, the Imp's fireball can either stun or down an Imp, making it easy to kill with a Finisher. Imps can also be knocked into its downed state or killed with a 3-hit combo from the Gauntlets or the Flail. If an Imps charge is parried, it will go into a stagger state.

=== Powered by Leader ===
If the Imp is powered by a leader, keep it immobile by throwing the Shield at it or by stunning it with a 3-hit combo, then finish it off with the Impaler/SSG.
